intro: Thirty-three years of commercial roofing across Northeastern Pennsylvania leaves a fairly visible trail. Hospitals in Danville, Scranton and Wilkes-Barre. A vaccine plant in Swiftwater and an army depot in Tobyhanna. A resort at Pocono Manor, a university in Wilkes-Barre, a community college in Nanticoke, and the airport in Avoca. Banks, supermarkets, school districts, apartment towers, manufacturing plants and shopping centres in between. The work below is a sample — if you want references on a building type like yours, ask and we will give you names.
